newsitem.title: NETHERLANDS: Philips seeks to shed cable interests-paper.
newsitem.headline: Philips seeks to shed cable interests-paper.

text.p: Philips Electronics NV is looking to shed its cable television interests, Dutch daily De Volkskrant said on Thursday.
Philips' cable television interests, which include stakes in Amsterdam, Eindhoven, Brussels and Vienna-based cable operators, total some 1.2 billion guilders, De Volkskrant said.

It said new Philips president Cor Boonstra aimed to hive off the interests, acquired by his predecessor Jan Timmer as a strategic foothold in the cable telephony/Internet market, because the massive investments required would take too long to earn back.
There was no-one immediately available for comment at Philips.
